name: Multipole Graph Neural Operator (MGNO)
summary: Approximate parametric PDE operators on graph meshes using multilevel long-range interactions.
summary_zh: 使用多层级图交互与类多极分解，在网格上近似全局算子。
core_idea: Use multipole-inspired hierarchy to capture far-field graph messages with favorable scaling.
innovation: Reduces the cost of capturing long-range interactions in graph-based PDE solution operator learning.
limitations: Performance depends on multilevel graph construction.
Accuracy for arbitrary patient-specific meshes needs separate validation.

start_here.focus: Graph hierarchy, long-range kernels and complexity.

curation_note: Representative publication checked; recommendations are advisory and application-specific clinical claims require separate evidence.
